name: Bubble sort
description: Repeatedly swap adjacent values until the array is sorted.

name: Binary search
description: Repeatedly halve a sorted array to locate a target value.

name: Maximum subarray
description: Use Kadane's algorithm to find the contiguous subarray with the largest sum.

name: Matrix transpose
description: Turn matrix rows into columns by reflecting values across the main diagonal.

name: Spiral matrix traversal
description: Visit every matrix cell clockwise from the outer boundary inward.

name: Rotate matrix
description: Rotate a square matrix 90 degrees clockwise in place.

name: In-order traversal
description: Visit the left subtree, root, and right subtree in order.

name: Pre-order traversal
description: Visit the root before recursively traversing its left and right subtrees.

name: Post-order traversal
description: Visit both subtrees before processing the root node.

name: Balanced parentheses
description: Use a stack to verify that every closing bracket matches its opener.

name: Postfix expression evaluation
description: Evaluate reverse Polish notation by applying operators to stacked operands.

name: Next greater element
description: Use a monotonic stack to find the next larger value for every element.

name: Breadth-first search
description: Use a queue to visit connected nodes one level at a time.

name: Generate binary numbers
description: Generate binary representations in order by expanding values through a queue.

name: Reverse a queue
description: Reverse queue order by transferring its values through a stack.

name: Reverse a linked list
description: Reverse every next pointer in a singly linked list.

name: Detect a linked-list cycle
description: Use Floyd's slow and fast pointers to detect a cycle.

name: Find the middle node
description: Advance one pointer twice as fast as another to find the list midpoint.

name: Two sum
description: Store previously seen values to find a pair matching the target sum.

name: Frequency counter
description: Count how often each value occurs using a hash table.

name: Group anagrams
description: Group words by a canonical sorted-letter key stored in a hash table.
